query:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing fullback, Bob is playing goalkeeper, and Claire is playing left midfielder.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Alice trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Finally, Alice and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) fullback
(B) goalkeeper
(C) left midfielder
note: UNLABELED external package; reference = first successful rollout; all other successful rollouts are omitted so the annotator view matches annotate.py

steps.content: Alice ends up playing left midfielder.
Alice ends up playing left midfielder.

NOTE Initially, Alice is in the fullback position, Bob in goalkeeper, and Claire in left midfielder. After the first swap, Claire and Alice trade positions. So, Alice is now in left midfielder and Claire is in fullback.
